export_encodec_checkpoint: export the best state from a trained EnCodec checkpoint to a lightweight release checkpoint file
export_pretrained_compression_model: export a pretrained compression model like facebook/encodec_32khz or dac_44khz for packaging with MusicGen
export_lm_checkpoint: export the best state from a MusicGen or AudioGen training checkpoint to a release checkpoint
review_export_encodec: review the export_encodec function to understand how EnCodec checkpoints are exported with best state and config
review_export_lm: review the export_lm function to understand how MusicGen and AudioGen checkpoints handle FSDP and standard states
